name: character
description: Default for new characters: 90s/2000s platformer look (Crash, Banjo-Kazooie), characterful, not cute.
prompt: Stylized 3D cartoon character render in the spirit of 90s/2000s platformers like Crash Bandicoot and Banjo-Kazooie: characterful and a little goofy rather than cute, normal-size eyes with personality, scruffy textured fur or rough skin, slightly exaggerated proportions, strong readable silhouette, a bit of attitude in the expression, warm saturated colors.
